text:
deploy-bot: starting canary deploy for `search-infer` -> v3.2.0-canary1. change window 23:00-00:00 UTC. initial traffic 5%. runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/backout#search-infer. auto-pin rules: cpu>88% OR p99>700ms for 3m -> auto-pin to v3.1.9. backout CLI: `redwoodctl rollback --service search-infer --to v3.1.9` :rotating_light:

maya: ack. i'll watch metrics and logs. grafana: https://grafana/redwood/search-infer. i'm on pager.

leo: quick question— if we need to pin, does deploybot change gateway weights or do we call infra proxy?

deploy-bot: deploybot will adjust gateway weights automatically when pinned. manual pin: `deploybot pin search-infer v3.1.9 --reason "canary-fail"`. proxy toggle (fallback) : `proxyctl set-route search-infer v3.1.9`.

ops-runner: checklist from runbook i have: 1) notify #incident-search, 2) run rollback command, 3) pin route, 4) scale down canary `kubectl scale deploy/search-infer-canary --replicas=0`, 5) if gpu errors, run `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used,utilization.gpu --format=csv`. runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/backout#search-checklist :white_check_mark:

leo: seeing p50 jump but p99 fine. logs show a handful of grpc 503s from model worker at 23:07.

maya: metrics to watch: p99 latency, error-rate (5xx > 0.8%), model worker restarts, GPU OOM. if we hit thresholds we rollback immediately.

deploy-bot: canary auto-ramped to 15% at 23:10 UTC. monitoring thresholds active.

leo: error-rate climbed to 0.9% at 23:12, p99 730ms. not yet sustained 3m.

maya: agreed threshold: error-rate >=1% for 2m OR p99>=700ms for 3m -> rollback. if borderline we hold for 8-10m and gather logs. ops-runner is backout lead.

ops-runner: standing by. if we rollback i'll run these exact commands:
```
# rollback steps
redwoodctl rollback --service search-infer --to v3.1.9
deploybot pin search-infer v3.1.9 --reason "canary error spike"
kubectl scale deploy/search-infer-canary --replicas=0
proxyctl set-route search-infer v3.1.9
# dedicated pool note
infractl pool-apply --pool search-infer-dedicated --model v3.1.9
```

leo: 23:15 error-rate 1.2% sustained 2m, p99 740ms. maya: authorize rollback?

maya: yes, proceed. ops-runner, go ahead.

ops-runner: executing `redwoodctl rollback --service search-infer --to v3.1.9` now.

deploy-bot: rollback in progress  progress: 10% -> 55% -> 100%.

ops-runner: pinned via `deploybot pin search-infer v3.1.9 --reason "canary fail"`. scaled canary down. ran proxy route set.

leo: monitoring shows errors dropping and p99 back to baseline. dedicated pool updated by infra.

release-czar: drafting customer note; will post to release page and notify impacted teams. ETA ~20m.

maya: leaving follow-up item in runbook: add a preflight check for new optimizer flags vs dedicated pools. also note: check model-worker grpc retry settings before next canary. i'll update runbook link.

ops-runner: backout completed at 23:18 UTC. cause suspected: model-worker version mismatch + optimizer default. postmortem to follow, assign SRE + ML infra.

deploy-bot: canary ended. traffic reverted to v3.1.9. closing thread after postmortem tasks assigned.
